meaning: Every source is revision-pinned. Historical documents, current code, new fixtures, inference and unexecuted proposals are distinct. The candidate name/synthesis is new in this task, not retroactively attributed to old papers.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: 2026-10-13 audit and repair commit; original baseline 715d1b567e3ed76e567b9462a4faf0fa513fce31 named by that audit.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: Aster scope selects a page whose body states the Other service port. The legacy reader returns candidate text.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The Aster service port has the value quoted for Other.
instances.why_insufficient: Lexical ownership/relevance does not bind the requested subject and relation to an eligible body statement.
instances.required_condition: Current eligible body evidence for the complete question under the finite grammar; conflicting support remains ambiguous.
instances.existing_enforcement: supported_answer checks eligible candidate bodies; pipeline/CLI keep candidate inspection separate.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Historical audit records four wrong legacy returns on held-out/adjacent pottery sets, refused by the new path at substantial coverage cost. This audit replays contracts, not those historical accuracy numbers.
instances.expected_behavior: Wrong-entity candidate remains available for inspection, strict answer refuses; correct body returns and competitors cause ambiguity.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Strong support for a narrower-operation-to-answer misclassification; not evidence of unrestricted entailment or a novel universal law.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Page-retrieval repair 2026-10-27, commit 2f2c17f9eb597b16ada7be0d5074d6d94b3f364b; current guide reviewed November 2.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: One page passes identity/path/hash/text/provenance checks and is returned with an accurate citation.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The returned page supports a requested interpretation, factual truth, or permission to act.
instances.why_insufficient: A citation locates bytes; it does not decide entailment, truth or permission.
instances.required_condition: Use the relevant answer, semantic assessment or authorization contract for the specific claim.
instances.existing_enforcement: retrieve always sets answer_supported:false and authority:source_page_retrieval, including successful retrieval.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Contract and adversarial missing-body-support regression exist; no separate observed production interpretation error is asserted here.
instances.expected_behavior: Retrieved wrong-entity page is not a supported answer; gate rejection withholds text/citation without replacement.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports the scoped non-entailment distinction; success is legitimate when the claim is only that a page was retrieved.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Eligibility is present in audited baseline; this audit does not assign one introduction date to every lineage guard.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: Previously accurate, sealed body text or a derivation remains stored after its basis is withdrawn.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The old page is currently eligible evidence for a supported answer or action.
instances.why_insufficient: Byte integrity and historical availability do not establish current lineage, delivery scope or source authority.
instances.required_condition: Recheck seals, current lineage, dependency status, profile restrictions and exclusions at use.
instances.existing_enforcement: gather/_lineage/_retired_dependencies and WorkStore._source/_effective recheck current eligibility.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Existing retirement/tamper tests are replayed; no new truth-verification feature or altered source hash is introduced.
instances.expected_behavior: Withdrawn bases and stale dependencies block current use; historical records remain recoverable under visibility policy.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports freshness/identity as claim-specific evidence; a historically valid observation need not be erased when current eligibility changes.

instances.initial_operation_and_result: An assisted reader supplies exact quotations and a separate semantic review.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The claim is deterministic source proof, calibrated truth, or independently validated general quality.
instances.why_insufficient: Span validity and model review differ from deterministic grammar support and external truth/calibration.
instances.required_condition: Report model-assessed authority and uncertainty; independent calibration/quality evidence is separate.
instances.existing_enforcement: Assisted outputs keep answer_supported:false; verification flags distinguish structural, semantic, truth and independence.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Audited implementation and documented outstanding evaluation, not a newly executed live-model experiment.
instances.expected_behavior: Model-assessed answers do not become deterministic supported answers. This module was not part of the 88-test focused replay.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports typed evidence limits, but does not supply empirical validation of the proposed synthesis.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Repository handoff introduced November 2 in aeafc6ecc071577b4db6636b7d08d07f662b41e4.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A handoff document and content manifest have been generated.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The handoff is current, complete, or the requested substantive work has been correctly finished.
instances.why_insufficient: Existence does not bind current tracked inputs or assess the semantic adequacy of the work.
instances.required_condition: Inventory and render must match current staged source; requested-content acceptance remains separate.
instances.existing_enforcement: build_handoff.check recomputes inventory hashes and the rendered update record; no generic task-quality oracle.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Existing tests reject changed instructions, tracked additions, tampered handoff and source modifications.
instances.expected_behavior: Stale or modified handoffs fail; a consistent handoff is not a source-ledger truth or completion certificate.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports the distinction between created and consistent; broader semantic verification must be named rather than assumed.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Manifest verifier introduced October 20 in a01a67afa6c364c708ed960921eb7e992113e123; new authored boundary control November 10.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A readable ZIP and preview with wrong requested content have mutually consistent hashes and authored fixture gate labels. Native manifest verification succeeds.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The generated artifact satisfies an arbitrary requested content criterion.
instances.why_insufficient: A coherent unsigned manifest cannot supply content semantics or authenticate its own fixture assertions.
instances.required_condition: A separately defined acceptance predicate and trusted producer/run provenance for the particular deliverable.
instances.existing_enforcement: Native verifier intentionally checks coherent trusted-CI inputs. It does not claim arbitrary semantic acceptance.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: New boundary control is observed in contract-replay.json. This is an expected trust boundary, not a newly established verifier defect. Fixture PASS labels are not claimed as executed CI results.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Shows why one generic artifact_verified flag is inadequate; it also refutes a blanket claim that a manifest gate alone prevents all promotion errors.

original_sources.location: Test the artifact you intend to ship

instances.initial_operation_and_result: Source/browser ZIPs are packaged from tracked source and supplied browser input, with checksums.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: Every supplied browser input was tested or the package fulfills every user acceptance criterion.
instances.why_insufficient: Packaging hashes identify submitted bytes. The caller must supply the intended tested browser build; arbitrary semantic acceptance is outside this packaging function.
instances.required_condition: Archive validation, correct candidate input, extracted tests and deliverable-specific acceptance evidence.
instances.existing_enforcement: Builder requires a current handoff/clean HEAD and uses git archive; CI separately tests the extracted candidate.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Documented operational input requirement. No new wrong-browser-input production defect is asserted or patched by this audit.
instances.expected_behavior: Content tampering and wrong expected commit fail relevant checks; packaging alone is not a general deliverable approval.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports narrower attestations and exposes dependence on caller discipline rather than just gate existence.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: ZIP-first release sequence documented October 19; current exact-head workflow inspected at audit baseline.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: Tests run successfully in a source checkout.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The separately packaged candidate ZIP is complete and works.
instances.why_insufficient: Packaging can omit/change dependencies or files, so the object tested and object delivered may differ.
instances.required_condition: Freeze exact commit/tree, archive, verify/extract, and run tests/build from that extraction.
instances.existing_enforcement: Workflow uses explicit PR head SHA, archive checksum, unzip and extracted working directories.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Engineering process and code enforcement observed; no fresh deliberately broken package was deployed.
instances.reproduction_command: Inspect .github/workflows/zip-release-validation.yml; run its extracted-ZIP workflow for the exact candidate.
instances.expected_behavior: Only exact extracted-candidate tests support candidate status; checkout passes remain narrower evidence.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports identity-bound checking; independent projects and controlled package faults remain future comparative work.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Candidate evidence manifest October 20; current verifier source unchanged at audit baseline.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: One commit or a previous candidate passed its tests and has a valid manifest.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: Another PR head is tested, or the candidate is already deployed/verified.
instances.why_insufficient: Evidence is attached to a particular identity and claim; candidate status is not deployment status.
instances.required_condition: Expected candidate commit, coherent hashes and required report labels under trusted CI; separate live evidence.
instances.existing_enforcement: Wrong commit/missing gates/tampering/forged deployed status fail; success status remains candidate_checks_passed_not_deployed.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Seven existing release-manifest regressions replayed; results are not a signature or hostile producer test.
instances.expected_behavior: Wrong head and stronger forged status reject; intact correct candidate is accepted as candidate only.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Strong support for type/scope/identity discipline already implemented, without a new promotion layer.

original_sources.location: Merge, deploy, and browser-test live again

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Current Pages workflow inspected at audit baseline; this audit does not claim it performed a new deployment fault experiment.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: Build/candidate tests pass and Pages deploy step completes.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: Observed public behavior is verified or all public bytes equal the tested candidate.
instances.why_insufficient: Upload completion is not a live behavioral check; a finite smoke test is not whole-site correctness or exact byte identity.
instances.required_condition: Run the public URL browser checks and record their scope/run/revision; full identity guarantees require an explicit deployed-digest binding.
instances.existing_enforcement: needs:build protects deployment ordering; live smoke/helper failures fail the job after deployment. They do not automatically roll back, prevent human overclaiming, or compare entire public HTML to candidate digest.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Existing postdeployment checks and limitations audited. No newly executed stale-site failure injection or digest-binding repair is claimed.
instances.expected_behavior: Behavioral failures reject smoke verification; a pass supports only observed checks, not every device, truth, future availability or full byte identity.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports distinct obligations, while showing that "verified" still needs an explicitly bounded claim.

original_sources.location: Required settings and historical setup gap

instances.historical_date_and_basis: October 20 missing required-check setup is documented; October 29 ruleset recheck is recorded. Fresh read-only settings observation retained for November 10.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A repository contains a workflow and release instructions.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: Main-branch merges are technically gated by required checks.
instances.why_insufficient: A workflow file does not configure server-side branch rules.
instances.required_condition: An active ruleset targeting main must require the actual current check contexts and appropriate bypass policy.
instances.existing_enforcement: Fresh ruleset observation shows active main-target PR, strict archive-first/regression requirements and no bypass actors; no failed-merge/bypass attempt was performed.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Historical setup gap is documented as repaired; current observation is not a durability guarantee or adversarial enforcement test.
instances.expected_behavior: Configuration observation is reported as observation, not as a proof that an attempted bad merge was blocked.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports separation of declarative intent from effective enforcement; also limits what the audit itself may claim.

instances.initial_operation_and_result: A successor can recover a filtered handoff with prior work and proposed actions.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: It inherits a predecessor capability or may execute after expiry/revocation/fencing.
instances.why_insufficient: Recovered data is not a current grant. Authorization is actor-, seat-, tool-, scope- and time-specific.
instances.required_condition: Fresh host-issued capability, current grant and fence, correct operation/tool/scope, dependencies and task revision at dispatch.
instances.existing_enforcement: handoff reconstructs snapshot under current grant; _actor/_permission/execute recheck state and reject stale credentials before dispatch.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Existing expiry/revocation/fencing, failed-route and dispatch guards replayed; external side effects remain non-atomic with local storage.
instances.expected_behavior: Old credentials reject and adapter calls remain absent; successor identity is new and does not certify truth.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports complete mediation/fresh authority, an existing engineering concern rather than an independent novel law.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Coordinator October 31; theory relates to the preserved September revisability manuscript.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A claim, repeated review or failed attempt survives interruption and appears in a handoff.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The claim becomes true/independently corroborated, or the failed route becomes an accepted success prerequisite.
instances.why_insufficient: Persistence and duplication add no new source support. A failed attempt can inform a decision without being a passing prerequisite.
instances.required_condition: Retain challenges, roots/spans, effective state and unsuccessful attempts; resolve with current evidence and separate rights.
instances.existing_enforcement: No terminal true assessment; challenges propagate; copied reviews record no new roots; failed routes are separate contextual links.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Five-instance deterministic fixture and copied-review/failed-context regressions exist and were replayed; not independent AI-provider performance.
instances.expected_behavior: Contested claims stay contested across owner revision, failed context survives, and successful allowed retry requires changed conditions.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Supports evidential non-amplification, but not a theorem that all repeated assessments are useless or no legitimate inference is possible.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Original coordinator October 31; new locally frozen counterexamples and minimal correction November 10.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A real host receipt reports a passed attempt under the old task revision. Baseline accepts an atomic done write that drops an unmet criterion, changes the goal, or replaces task input pins.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The new task contract is completed by evidence for the old contract.
instances.why_insufficient: Existing receipt revision/criterion-name checks did not compare the proposed completion contract with the pre-completion contract in the same write.
instances.required_condition: Preserve goal, review policy, criterion set and task input pins when consuming the receipt; deliberately revise while open and execute again when they change.
instances.existing_enforcement: Baseline had receipt/status/freshness/coverage gates but missed this atomic contract-substitution case. New seven-line local guard closes it without changing answer/permission authority.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Before: three new rejection assertions fail; two valid controls pass. After: all five pass. Same tests/interpreter/fixtures used against archived old store and patched store.
instances.expected_behavior: Baseline accepts all three prohibited writes; patched implementation rejects them, accepts reordered identical criteria and freshly rerun revised tasks.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: A concrete additional instance consistent with the proposed abstraction. Three invented local cases do not establish four-domain population effects or novelty.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: Manuscript has no established internal authoring date; repository first retained it October 8. Do not substitute the retention date for publication or experiment date.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: A visible, detailed trajectory is published or recovered.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The claim is validated or clarity has been demonstrated merely by visibility.
instances.why_insufficient: The paper distinguishes validation from clarity and demands visible retraction for its proposed clarity test; its kill conditions are explicitly untested.
instances.required_condition: Claim-specific adjudication; test whether the paper’s proposed retraction criterion itself survives counterexamples.
instances.existing_enforcement: This is a manuscript proposal and source for the audit, not an executable gate or independent scientific validation.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: The manuscript self-reports a PHA retraction. This audit did not independently reproduce that external experiment or validate its general necessity claim.
instances.reproduction_command: Read papers/Clarity_Is_Not_Validation.txt sections 1, 3 and 6 at the pinned revision.
instances.expected_behavior: Treat the distinctions as attributed formulations and the positive clarity criterion as falsifiable, not an established universal rule.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Conceptually related, but its normative/epistemic criteria are not identical to a software postcondition. It cannot by itself prove the cross-domain mechanism.

instances.historical_date_and_basis: September 2026 printed on PDF page 1; first repository retention October 8. PDF pages 1–3 contain the continuity/revisability distinction.
instances.initial_operation_and_result: An earlier working conclusion is mechanically recovered in a new runtime.
instances.stronger_downstream_claim: The inherited premise has gained evidential support or should remain a terminal fact.
instances.why_insufficient: An inference can survive without its uncertainty; the recovery operation does not supply the missing epistemic basis.
instances.required_condition: Retain observation/inference, assumptions, contrary evidence, dependencies and revisiting conditions.
instances.existing_enforcement: Coordinator stores these distinctions and computes effective state; it does not adjudicate arbitrary propositions as true.
instances.recorded_failure_and_repair: Original manuscript supplies a supplier/configuration example; coordinator’s five-instance realization is a deterministic development fixture.
instances.expected_behavior: Recovery exposes prior failed/contested work and requires current rights; no five-provider or universal semantic validation follows.
instances.shared_principle_assessment: Strong source support for the work-state component of the new synthesis; not evidence the exact proposed name/formula already existed.
